compiled_state.title: As a plugin maintainer, onboarding, CI generator, and installer tools write project-type-appropriate merge and enforcement defaults
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Update /dso:onboarding, ci-generator.sh, create-dso-app.sh, github-bootstrap.sh, and CLAUDE.md to surface the merge strategy choice and write correct defaults per project type.
**Why**: Without this story, the PR-mode infrastructure exists but new projects default to broken behavior, and agents following CLAUDE.md will misapply the 7-phase pipeline to PR-mode projects.
**Scope**:
- IN: /dso:onboarding direct/pr selection question + provision-ruleset.sh trigger on pr selection (idempotent); ci-generator.sh --mode=pr-protected variant with Resolve-and-fetch step and validate-required-checks.sh reference; create-dso-app.sh writes merge.strategy=direct, enforcement.strategy=local to new project dso-config.conf and does NOT provision Ruleset; digital-service-orchestra-nextjs-template checked-in dso-config.conf updated; github-bootstrap.sh conditional push (merge.strategy=direct OR unprovisioned ruleset; clear error for PR-mode with pre-existing ruleset); CLAUDE.md Task Completion Workflow clarification for PR vs direct mode phases
- OUT: provision-ruleset.sh knob implementation (S5); hook gating implementation (S2)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, /dso:onboarding asks the user to choose between direct and pr (defaulting to direct for non-technical users) and writes the choice to dso-config.conf; selecting pr triggers provision-ruleset.sh automatically; the trigger is idempotent on re-runs
  <- Satisfies: "/dso:onboarding asks the user to choose between direct and pr (defaulting to direct for non-technical users) and writes the choice to dso-config.conf; selecting pr triggers provision-ruleset.sh automatically"
- When this story is complete, ci-generator.sh gains a --mode=pr-protected variant; the generated workflow includes the Resolve-and-fetch DSO plugin assets step; validate-required-checks.sh is referenced to catch alignment drift
  <- Satisfies: "ci-generator.sh and ci-skeleton-templates.md gain a sibling PR-mode template variant exposed via ci-generator.sh --mode=pr-protected"
- When this story is complete, create-dso-app.sh writes merge.strategy=direct, enforcement.strategy=local to new project dso-config.conf and does NOT provision a Ruleset; digital-service-orchestra-nextjs-template's checked-in dso-config.conf matches
  <- Satisfies: "create-dso-app.sh writes merge.strategy=direct and enforcement.strategy=local to the new project's dso-config.conf"
- When this story is complete, github-bootstrap.sh git push escape hatch is conditional on merge.strategy=direct OR an as-yet-unprovisioned Ruleset; on PR-mode projects with a pre-existing Ruleset, the script surfaces a clear error directing the user to disable the Ruleset for the bootstrap window
  <- Satisfies: "plugins/dso/scripts/onboarding/github-bootstrap.sh updated so its git push origin HEAD:main escape hatch is conditional"
- When this story is complete, CLAUDE.md Task Completion Workflow section is updated to clarify which phases run in direct vs PR mode (in PR mode: validate may be delegated to CI, push becomes gh pr create + auto-merge wait, ci_trigger is implicit)
  <- Satisfies: implied by residual-references finding (normative 7-phase pipeline documentation)
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Reliability] Onboarding provision-ruleset.sh trigger must be idempotent on re-runs; check for existing Ruleset before creating
- [Maintainability] ci-generator.sh --mode=pr-protected must reference validate-required-checks.sh to catch check-name alignment drift between workflow and required-checks.txt

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
